profile.name: Afonso Lima
profile.description: Computer Engineering student in Portugal. Full-stack development is my hobby: I build mobile apps, websites, and management systems, and I enjoy watching people use them.

spotlight.label: Currently building
spotlight.title: HabitWar
spotlight.description: A gamified habit tracker where you battle friends: keep your streaks alive, climb the leaderboard, and prove your habits with photos, timers, and location. Built with React Native and Expo on a Supabase backend, with subscriptions, push notifications, and home screen widgets.

HabitWar.title: HabitWar
HabitWar.description: Gamified habit tracking app for iOS and Android. Battle friends, keep streaks, and verify habits with photo, timer, and location proof. Full product: auth, subscriptions, widgets, and analytics.

about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm Afonso Lima, a Computer Engineering student at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Porto. Outside classes, I build full-stack projects for fun: HabitWar, a habit tracking app for iOS and Android, plus websites and booking systems for people around me. I mostly work with React, React Native with Expo, TypeScript, Node.js, Supabase, and PostgreSQL, and I also enjoy C++, Java, and Python. Outside the digital world, I'm a national boxing champion, an important part of my background and identity.
